newsitem.title: CHINA: China military pledges allegiance to Jiang Zemin.
newsitem.headline: China military pledges allegiance to Jiang Zemin.

text.p: China's military mourned the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping on Saturday and pledged allegiance to its commander Jiang Zemin, the Xinhua news agency said.
The three million-strong People's Liberation Army (PLA) would "strengthen their adherence to Deng's and Jiang's instructions on army building", Xinhua said.
The three departments of the PLA expressed their profound grief over the death of Deng Xiaoping on Wednesday, it said.

The Headquarters of General Staff, the General Political Department and the General Logistics Department voiced their determination to rally closely round the Communist Party leadership and the Military Commission with Jiang at the core, it added.
Jiang is chairman of the party's powerful Central Military Commission as well as Communist Party chief and state president.
"The three bodies vowed to obey the leadership of the Communist Party Central Committee and the Military Commission in a steadfast way and to ensure the army's unity," Xinhua said.

Fu Quanyou, the head of PLA Headquarters of the General Staff, said his subordinates would put themselves under the command of the Central Committee and the Military Commission with Jiang at the core.

Wang Ke, director of the PLA General Logistics Department, called on all members of his department to carry out Deng's behest and support the authority of the Central Committee and the Military Commission.
Yu Yongbo, director of the PLA General Political Department, said his department would never waver in its resolve to maintain perfect stability and unity in the armed forces.
The military had pledged allegiance to Jiang on Thursday, one day after Deng's death.
